items.text: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) was downgraded to out Saturday and misses a third straight game; Tyler Huntley starts.

Final report: Baltimore also ruled out OLB Tavius Robinson (pectoral) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee); CB T.J. Tampa (knee) is doubtful and DT Broderick Washington (ankle) questionable. Cincinnati has no injury designations; Joe Burrow starts.
